title: Native end-to-end user journey automation
summary: Playwright end-to-end suite driving real Chromium against the built frontend, covering the complete user journey from cold start through diagnostics export, plus theme persistence and Quiet Mode suppression.

implementation.target: prebuilt desktop/dist served over a local static server on 127.0.0.1:4321
implementation.note: No Tauri runtime or venue network access required, so the suite runs on any CI host.

journeys.name: cold start
asserts: semantic nav and main landmarks render
offline demo fixture mode explicitly labelled

journeys.name: deterministic offline replay
asserts: input hash (SHA-256) displayed and matches recorded value 57d6a83e...

journeys.name: diagnostics incident bundle export
asserts: latency distribution p50/p95/p99 column headers visible
export bundle produces offline reproduction bundle

journeys.name: theme persistence
asserts: choice survives a full page reload (localStorage persistence)

journeys.name: quiet mode suppression
asserts: audio chime (afplay) enabled before quiet mode
enabling quiet mode disables and unchecks afplay and say controls
controls remain visible so suppression is explicit, not hidden

accessibility_defects_found_and_repaired.description: Form labels in CostComparisonView had no htmlFor/id association, so inputs were unreachable by accessible name and undrivable by assistive technology. Discovered because getByLabel failed in a real browser.
accessibility_defects_found_and_repaired.fix: Added id + htmlFor pairs for amount, symbol, and balance inputs

accessibility_defects_found_and_repaired.description: Notification checkboxes in SettingsView lacked id associations and gave no explanation of Quiet Mode behaviour.
accessibility_defects_found_and_repaired.fix: Added id + htmlFor pairs and an aria-describedby hint for the playback controls

build_integration.reason: Disjoint globs prevent each runner from loading the other's fixtures and hooks; overlapping globs previously caused Playwright's beforeAll to execute inside vitest and fail.

gate_integration.behavior: Builds desktop/dist if absent, then runs the suite; a missing build fails loudly rather than silently skipping
